findings.claim: The new `--server-url` option is documented in the file header, but this hunk contains no corresponding change to the `parseArgs` option map, the runtime `--help` output, or the OpenAPI document generation, so the flag may be undocumented-in-help or outright unsupported at runtime.
findings.rationale: `node:util` `parseArgs` throws `ERR_PARSE_ARGS_UNKNOWN_OPTION` for options not declared in its `options` config (unless `strict: false`), so documenting a flag without registering it would make `--server-url` a hard CLI error rather than a no-op. The header comment is also typically duplicated by a printed help string; if only the comment was updated, `--help` will not mention the flag. I cannot see the rest of the file in this hunk, so this is a low-to-medium confidence flag for verification rather than a confirmed defect.
